design_notes: Use a single accent colour (e.g., #003366) for table headers and pull-quote rule.
Tables should have hairline borders, left-aligned text in first column, right-aligned numbers in data columns.
Pull-quote should be set in a larger serif font, with a thin rule above and below, and the accent colour for the rule.
Sidebar should be boxed with a thin rule, background tinted lightly (e.g., #f5f5f5), and set in a slightly smaller serif font.
No decorative imagery or icons; use only typographic hierarchy and rules.
